title: Update sourcing talents page to use Paraglide JS
description:
Migrate the sourcing talents page from dynamic .ts file loading to Paraglide JS message functions.

Tasks:
1. Update src/routes/[lang]/sourcing-talents/[[targetName]]/+page.server.ts
2. Remove dynamic import.meta.glob() logic for .ts files
3. Integrate with Paraglide message functions
4. Ensure targetName parameter handling still works
5. Test with both English and French content

Current implementation uses:
- import.meta.glob('./*.ts') to load language files
- Dynamic loading based on lang parameter
- Manual content passing to components

New implementation will use:
- Direct Paraglide message imports
- Automatic locale-based message resolution
- No manual content passing needed

Files involved:
- src/routes/[lang]/sourcing-talents/[[targetName]]/+page.server.ts
- src/routes/[lang]/sourcing-talents/[[targetName]]/fr.ts (to be removed)

title: Update section components to use Paraglide message functions
description:
Migrate all 9 section components from content.key pattern to m.messageKey() pattern and remove translation props.

Components to update:
1. HeroSection.svelte - Update hero content references
2. BenefitsSection.svelte - Convert nested benefits structure
3. Benefits2Section.svelte - Update additional benefits
4. MembershipSection.svelte - Convert membership plans
5. WhyWorkUsSection.svelte - Update work reasons
6. PlansSection.svelte - Convert subscription plans
7. FaqsSection.svelte - Update FAQ content
8. TerminalMessage.svelte - Update terminal messages

For each component:
- Import * as m from '$paraglide/messages.js'
- Replace {content.key} with {m.key()}
- Remove export let content prop
- Update any TypeScript interfaces
- Test with both languages

Files involved:
- src/lib/sections/*.svelte (9 files)

title: Migrate to Paraglide JS - Epic
description:
Migrate the entire custom TypeScript-based internationalization system from fr.ts/en.ts files to Paraglide JS. This involves migrating ~200 translation keys across 3 files, updating 9+ components, and maintaining existing URL routing structure.

Key objectives:
- Migrate all translation content to Paraglide message format
- Update components to use m.messageKey() pattern instead of content.key
- Preserve /[lang]/ URL routing structure
- Ensure server-side rendering works with Paraglide
- Remove old .ts translation files after successful migration
